newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Central Europe's CESI comes down from highs.
newsitem.headline: Central Europe's CESI comes down from highs.

text.p: The CESI Central European Share Index fell on Tuesday to close at 1,531.04 points, down 13.66 points or 0.88 percent, the Budapest Stock Stock Exchange said.
The index which reached three successive highs in the past three days, fell as most shares of the CESI basket closed lower.
The index, which has been published since February 1, reflects trends of 50 shares on the Budapest, Prague and Warsaw bourses.
